# Contact Details Scraper

The Apify actor [`vdrmota/contact-info-scraper`](https://apify.com/vdrmota/contact-info-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.2.243**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Email extractor and lead scraper to extract and download emails, phone numbers, Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads, Snapchat, and Telegram profiles from any website. Extract contact information at scale from lists of URLs and download the data as Excel, CSV, JSON, HTML, and XML.

## Pricing

Pay per event — scraped page $0.002, Actor start per 1 GB $0.001, Add-on: Business leads enrichment $0.1, Add-on: Social media profile enrichment $0.1, Extra: Page opened with a residential proxy $0.002, Extra: Page opened with a browser $0.003, Extra: Extended loading per page $0.005, Add-on: Email verification $0.1 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/vdrmota/contact-info-scraper) for current prices.

imports:

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      startUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | array | yes |  | Start URLs — The list of web pages from which the scraper will start crawling. You can also pass Linktree (https://linktr.ee) (linktr.ee) link-in-bio pages. The Actor reads every link on the profile and scrapes those linked sites for contact details, even with Stay within domain enabled. |
| `maxRequestsPerStartUrl` | integer |  |  | Maximum pages per start URL — The maximum number of pages that will be enqueued from each start URL you provide. |
| `mergeContacts` | boolean |  | `true` | Merge contacts — Enable this option to merge all contacts and social media from every page of the same start URL into a single, clean result row. |
| `maxDepth` | integer |  |  | Maximum link depth — The maximum number of links away from the Start URLs that the Actor will crawl. If 0, the scraper will not follow any links. If empty or null, the scraper will follow links to an arbitrary depth. |
| `maxRequests` | integer |  |  | Maximum pages for whole scrape — The maximum number of pages the scraper will load. It is always a good idea to limit the number of pages, otherwise the scraper might run infinitely or consume too many resources. |
| `sameDomain` | boolean |  | `true` | Stay within domain — If set, the scraper will only follow links within the same domain as the referring page. Links found on a Linktree (https://linktr.ee) (linktr.ee) page are an exception - they are always followed, even when this is enabled. |
| `considerChildFrames` | boolean |  | `true` | Scrape iframes — If set, the scraper will also extract contact information from iframes. You might not always want this (e.g. it will include data from online ads). |
| `maximumLeadsEnrichmentRecords` | integer |  | `0` | ⏩ Add-on: Extract business leads information - Maximum leads per domain ($) — Set the maximum number of lead records to scrape per domain found. Default is 0, meaning no leads are scraped. ⚠️ This returns personal data. You're responsible for having a legal basis to collect and use it under privacy  |
| `leadsEnrichmentDepartments` | string[] |  |  | Filter by department — Include only specific departments (e.g. Sales, Marketing, or C-Suite). Only works when the Maximum leads per domain add-on (maximumLeadsEnrichmentRecords) is enabled. Note that some job titles may be miscategorized. |
| `verifyLeadsEnrichmentEmails` | boolean |  | `false` | ⏩ Add-on: Email verification ($) — When enabled, verifies the email address of each lead extracted during business leads enrichment. Each lead receives an emailVerification object with the verification result and quality assessment. Charged (decisive results): valid (ok), invalid, and disposable ema |
| `scrapeSocialMediaProfiles` | object |  | `{"facebooks":false,"instagrams":false,"youtubes":false,"tikt` | 🔍 Add-on: Social media profile enrichment ($) — Enriched profiles are available in the Social profiles output tab. See the section description above for what data is retrieved and how it's priced. ⚠️ This returns personal data. You're responsible for having a legal basis to collect and use it under |
| `useBrowser` | boolean |  | `false` | Use browser for scraping — If set, the scraper will use a browser for crawling the pages. |
| `waitUntil` | string |  | `"domcontentloaded"` | When to consider a page loaded — Select when a page should be considered loaded so that the Actor can start scraping it. *Only works with the browser.* |
| `proxyConfig` | object | yes | `{"useApifyProxy":true}` | Proxy — Proxy servers let you bypass website protections, avoid IP address blocking, and view content for other countries. Try to use a proxy if you are experiencing timeout errors. |
